assumptions.message: Delivery fee is specified upon creation by the shop as an incentive payout for the courier.
Customer tracking is made publicly available by ID so customers do not need to register an account.
DriverProfile holds online status per driver to enforce the rule that couriers must be online.
Three separate application areas created for Shop, Driver, and Dispatcher to match their distinct operational workflows.

Design direction: Food Delivery / On-Demand (Hero-Centric Design + Feature-Rich); palette Appetizing warm (orange/red) + trust blue + map accent; fonts Startup Bold (Outfit + Rubik) (Outfit / Rubik); from ui-ux-pro-max@28b3b8dee8c9
